_comment: Scenes for tools/check/picture_check.py: each is captured at `seconds` of game time from a fresh save, with `env` driving the game there (PUNCHOUT_INPUT presses, PUNCHOUT_POINTER moves; see docs/runtime.md). `max_rmse` is the largest root-mean-square difference from Dolphin's render of the same frame allowed, as a percentage of full scale, and `max_off` the largest share of pixels (percent) more than 48 of 255 off in any channel. Scenes marked slow are skipped unless --slow is given; scenes marked needs_save start from a copy of --save's saves (a profile), and are skipped without it. The scripts here are for a save with one profile (a default Mii).
